about: Verification cases for the website's verdicts. The first 256 were drawn at random (seed 20261003), 8 hadiths from each of the eight Shamela editions: the first ten words of the hadith's matn, written without diacritics as a visitor types, and three changes of them. The rest were written by the team: well-known hadiths in a visitor's own words, and sayings that none of the eight books holds (modern sentences, proverbs, sayings wrongly attributed to the Prophet ﷺ).

kinds.exact: the words as the book has them → «same text» (verified or found), with a hadith holding them first
kinds.missing2: two of the words left out → a distortion warning, the same hadith first (8 of its 10 words in it)
kinds.changed1: one word changed → a distortion warning, the same hadith first (8 of its 10 words in it)
kinds.first5: the first five words only → «same text», with a hadith holding them first
kinds.own_words: a hadith in a visitor's own words → a distortion warning (or «same text», where the words are one of the hadith's own wordings), with that hadith first
